{"subject":"Checking in from Harbor Street","body":"Hi,

I wanted to send a quick hello and see how things are going at Mintlify. I'd love to hear what the team is focused on right now and what's been keeping you busy.

If it's useful, I'm happy to set up a 20-minute call whenever suits you. No agenda, just a chance to catch up and hear where things are headed.

Either way, wishing you and the team a strong stretch ahead.

Best,
Elena"}
